title: galium rotundifolium var. javanicum
intro: Galium rotundifolium var. javanicum, commonly known as Java Bedstraw, is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family, native to Java, Indonesia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in promoting digestive health and relieving gastrointestinal issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Java Bedstraw include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
